import json, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
server='/Volumes/KINGSTON/AIVERSE-builds/building-caverns-gate-build/aiversemcp'
def session(calls):
    requests=[('initialize',{'protocolVersion':'2024-11-05','capabilities':{},'clientInfo':{'name':'caverns-roundtrip','version':'1'}})]
    requests += [('tools/call',{'name':name,'arguments':args}) for name,args in calls]
    payload=''.join(json.dumps(dict(jsonrpc='2.0',id=i,method=m,params=p))+'\n' for i,(m,p) in enumerate(requests))
    result=subprocess.run([server,'--no-editor','--engine',os.getcwd(),'--port','0'],input=payload,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=45,check=True)
    rows={r['id']:r for r in map(json.loads,result.stdout.splitlines()) if 'id' in r}
    values=[]
    for i in range(1,len(requests)):
        r=rows[i]['result']
        assert not r.get('isError'),(calls[i-1][0],r)
        values.append(json.loads(r['content'][0]['text']))
    return values
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    project=Path(folder)/'sample'
    shutil.copytree('examples/projectiles',project)
    open_game=('open_game',{'game':str(project)})
    op='terraweave_caverns_paint'
    get=(op,{'mode':'get'})
    carve=(op,dict(mode='carve',xCm=-750,yCm=-2000,zCm=800,radiusCm=400))
    fill=(op,dict(mode='fill',xCm=-750,yCm=-2000,zCm=800,radiusCm=200))
    r=session([open_game,get,carve,fill,('undo',{}),get,('redo',{}),get,('map_save',{})])
    n=r[1]['stampCount']
    assert [r[i]['stampCount'] for i in (2,3,5,7)]==[n+1,n+2,n+1,n+2]
    reopened=session([open_game,get])[1]
    assert reopened['snapshot']==r[7]['snapshot'] and reopened['stampIds']==r[7]['stampIds']
    print('PASS real native MCP carve/fill, undo and redo, map save, fresh process reopen and full snapshot equality')
